name: APB
recent: APB 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日与 Darul Ehsan Investment Group 签署有条件买卖协议，以 RM45.00 million 现金出售位于 Shah Alam 的 16 层办公楼 Menara APB。公司于 11 月 23 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。11 月 24 日，Tee Jun Shern 在董事会及多个委员会出现人事变动。
notable: Tee Jun Shern 出现董事会及薪酬、审计、提名委员会的人事变动。
2026 年 9 月 14 日召开的第 24 届常年股东大会所有决议以 poll 方式通过。
risks: 拟议出售 Menara APB 的代价较市场价值折让 RM1.00 million。
出售所得款项中 RM37.00 million 将用于偿还债务。

recent_en: APB signed a conditional sale and purchase agreement on 6 November 2026 with Darul Ehsan Investment Group to dispose of the 16-storey Menara APB office building in Shah Alam for RM45.00 million cash. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November. On 24 November, Tee Jun Shern had changes in the boardroom and several committees.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of Menara APB to Darul Ehsan Investment Group Berhad for RM45.00 million cash.
Tee Jun Shern had changes in the boardroom and the remuneration, audit and nomination committees.
All resolutions at the 24th AGM held on 14 September 2026 were passed by poll.
risks_en: The proposed disposal consideration for Menara APB is RM1.00 million below market value.
RM37.00 million of the disposal proceeds will be used to repay debt.
